# T-3: Expose official roots

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make senti source or tests explicitly expose the real sibling roots separately from bundled compatibility roots.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Tests can assert when sibling roots are missing.
- Bundled src/official-plugins roots remain distinguishable.
- Upgrade migration still resolves official packages.
- Unenabled non-base official presets are unavailable until the sibling-sourced plugin package is enabled.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a small helper surface over embedding absolute paths in unrelated production code. Keep source distribution rules in mind for src/. Update preset discovery so core built-ins come from src/presets/base and non-base official presets come through enabled plugin contributions.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for root resolution and upgrade source selection.
